name: Mukhyamantri Raut, Charavaaha Evan Doodh Duhane Vaale Saayakal Sahaayata Yojana
briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Raut, Charavaaha Evan Doodh Duhane Vaale Bicycle Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 10 September 2013.
descriptionMd: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme &quot;Mukhyamantri Raut, Charavaaha Evan Doodh Duhane Vaale Bicycle Sahaayata Yojana&quot; for unorganized worker on 10 September 2013. The main objective of the scheme to empower unorganized worker by providing financial assistance.
benefitsMd: > Financial Assistance of ₹ 3,000/- per person for bicycle or the rate fixed by CSIDC for bicycle which will be lower
eligibilityMd:
1. Applicant must be registered as an unorganized worker in any district of the state. 
1. Applicant must be between the ages of 18 and 60. 
1. Unorganized workers who are receiving benefits from any other parallel scheme of the State Government are not eligible for the scheme.
